notes.title: Six One Indie Showcase + Release Date Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're accelerating towards launch now, and I'm happy to announce that ADRIFT is part of the Six One Indie Showcase. I'm really excited to be one of the 47 indies that have been chosen to be part of the event![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QncfsZr_fxQ"]You can catch the full showcase here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I'm also proud to announce that ADRIFT will release on [b]October 30th. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="NV6cN_ji49k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]There's still time to jump into the demo for ADRIFT! If you enjoyed your time with it, please consider leaving a review - it helps a lot for discoverability on Steam and will help me with feedback in the run up to launch![/p][p][/p][p]Also please consider wishlisting, I'll be dropping some DevLogs in October about my experience making the game and some of the inspirations behind it. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned,[/p][p][/p][p]Stefan, S.K.9.8[/p]

notes.title: Short Games Showcase
notes.content: [p]Hey folks![/p][p]We're back to back on showcases and I'm delighted that ADRIFT has been selected to be part of Short Games Showcase.[/p][p]ADRIFT is my first game, and it's designed to be short, contemplative experience as you chart your own path through the world. You'll have the opportunity to discover hidden poetry as you make your way down the winding roads, and explore the non-linear areas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/4bc6fabcee1f4876da75c70d3c491790ac66b17f.png"][/img][/p][p]I've learned a lot while making this game, and look forward to taking those learnings to future projects, but first I need to launch ADRIFT! I'm currently working towards launch, finishing off some levels and focusing on some polish.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more details on the launch, and if you enjoyed the demo, please consider wishlisting and dropping a review on the demo page![/p][p]See you round the bend,[/p][p]Stefan, S.K.9.8[/p]

notes.title: ADRIFT at ChinaJoy!
notes.content:

[/p][p]I’d just thought I’d give you a quick update on everything that’s been happening since Steam Next Fest. I’ve been super busy adding more and more content as I set my sights on launch (More on that soon!)[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been an amazing journey so far, and I’m still learning a lot so I’d like to say thank you once again to everyone who played and gave feedback during Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]Also, I’m delighted to announce that ADRIFT is taking part in ChinaJoy! Thanks to the organisers for accepting me into their showcase. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/512572f8a5d28f1c3edb10d7a7593031a2aaa1aa.gif"][/img][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the demo. If you have a good time, please consider leaving a review. It helps a lot with the Steam algorithms and maybe more importantly, helps me gather feedback on what people are enjoying and what could do with some tuning up! [/p][p] [/p][p]That’s all for today, please consider wishlisting the game and stay tuned for more details on launch soon![/p][p] [/p][p]See you round the bend,[/p][p][/p][p]Stefan, S.K.9.8[/p][p]

notes.title: The Journey Continues...
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!
[/p][p]Steam Next Fest has been a great experience, with new folks checking out the demo for ADRIFT. We've received valuable feedback and discovered some bugs I wasn't aware of. It's one of those rare occasions where finding a bug is a positive outcome!  The more I can squash on the way to launch, the better!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/0be581029c0cf234e0f7ed8c415cf3a383234422.gif"][/img][/p][p]With that in mind, I'm going to keep the demo available online for a little while longer, releasing small fixes and updates as I go. So, if you have found a bug, be sure to let me know! 
[/p][p]I'm also extending the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2903570/view/532100473328501267?l=english"]Speedrunning Content[/url] so that as many of you as possible get a chance to participate. You can leave you times in the comments here or in the Steam Community Forums.
[/p][p]See you down the road, 
[/p][p]Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Bug Fixes, New Demo Page & Community Speedrunning Competition
notes.content:
[p]Happy weekend! [/p][p][/p][p]Following on from some feedback on the demo, I've fixed some bugs that included crashes after the early ferry cutscene that was afflicting certain players. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't already played the demo recently, the latest version introduced a lot of quality of life improvements. A new checkpoint after the ferry section, some adjustments to the onboarding experience, smoothed out interacting/dropping/swapping cargo and more. Alongside that, a lot of smaller changes were made under the bonnet that I won't list here (just know that they cleaned up a lot of messy corners). [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/0be581029c0cf234e0f7ed8c415cf3a383234422.gif"][/img][/p][p]The demo timer that was added can also be used to enter [b]a competition to win full game keys[/b] when the game comes out later this year! All you have to do is share a screenshot of your time either here or on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/sk98games.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url] and we'll select some random winners at the end of Next Fest. [/p][p][/p][p]The current time to beat is just over 12 minutes - I'm looking forward to seeing how you fare! [/p][p][/p][p]See you in the dunes, [/p][p][/p][p]Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/sk98games.bsky.social" style="button"]Follow me on Bluesky[/url]
[/p]

notes.title: Speedrunning Contest
notes.content:
Hi there!

Steam Next Fest is almost here! I’ve got some updates coming to the ADRIFT demo (more on that soon), but one fun new addition is a timer at the end of your run. It’s great for seeing how long your journey took, and even better for a bit of friendly competition.

ADRIFT is all about chilled-out exploration… until you pick up your cargo. Then it’s all about speed. So: who can deliver their cargo the [b]fastest[/b]?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/8319f2db53c5d01d144ecb5155e403613bdb0ed0.png[/img]
Once the updated demo is live, share a screenshot of your best time here or on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/sk98games.bsky.social]BlueSky.[/url] The fastest run will [b]win one of three copies of ADRIFT at launch![/b]

The key will be learning the map, finding your route, and then finding a better one. The game’s full of different paths and shortcuts, and I’d love to see how you get it done. If you’re recording or streaming your run, even better (but not required)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/8dbee2e8c84d24157648053f617bec1fd886970d.png[/img]
More details on the updated demo coming soon.

See you down the road, 

Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8

notes.title: Press Highlights & A Big Thank You!
notes.content:
Hi there!

The demo for ADRIFT is out in the wild, and I’ve honestly been floored by the response. It’s hard to put into words how grateful I am to everyone who’s taken the time to play, share their thoughts, or even just post a screenshot. Seeing folks vibing with the atmosphere, the drifting, and making their deliveries (or blowing up, it’s one of the two really) means the world to me. So truly: [b]thank you.[/b]

On top of that, ADRIFT has been getting picked up by some press outlets, which is still kind of surreal to write out. I wanted to share a few highlights in case you missed them:

Firstly, [b]PC Gamer[/b] described the game as "[i]aggressively vaporwave[/i]" which is a hell of an accolade. I might have to use that line later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/55c67e5291f1c97f92c709c9c76d63d1126349d0.png[/img]
[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/racing/this-aggressively-vaporwave-offroad-driving-game-by-a-car-mechanic-turned-solo-dev-just-got-a-steam-demo/]Read more here[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Engadget[/b] featured the game in a list of “[i]indie games worth checking out[/i]”... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/5a9be3be8a5733d0afde5a23ce90f75564a4872a.png[/img]
[url=https://www.engadget.com/gaming/remastered-eldritch-terror-a-fantasy-life-sim-and-other-new-indie-games-worth-checking-out-110015794.html]Read more here[/url]
[hr][/hr]
It’s also been featured on [b]4Gamers[/b], [b]Reboot[/b], and a few other places I never expected to see the game pop up:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/a9d4ce311bd9c22cd9a7e132704b670e0ae7315e.png[/img]
[url=https://www.4gamers.com.tw/news/detail/71866/retro-inspired-offroad-driving-adventure-game-adrift-releases-playable-demo-on-steam]Read more here[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/6cee82d5d6c82e7b159027231584926e99a78b96.png[/img]
[url=https://reboot.hr/adrift-donosi-istrazivanje-driftajte-i-prezivljavanje-u-vaporwave-pustinji/]Read more here[/url]
[hr][/hr]
I’ve been building this game quietly for a long time, mostly just hoping it might resonate with a few people. To now see it getting coverage from places I’ve read for years? Genuinely a bit mind-blowing.

If you haven’t played the demo yet you can still check it out, and while you’re here be sure to give me a follow on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/sk98games.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] where I post smaller updates about the game. 

See you down the road, 

Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8

notes.title: The ADRIFT Demo is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hi there!

Today is the day! The Demo for ADRIFT is available to download and play [b]RIGHT NOW![/b]

ADRIFT began its life as a student project of mine and I just never stopped working on it. I wanted to create something that could give you the zen-like sensation of driving, the thrill of exploration and then the real pressure of delivering a vital cargo on time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/a174e6b49f006fd5ffd7581e24c00a8577fb07e8.png[/img]
In this first small section of the game you’ll get a taste for what it’s like to hit the dunes, drift, and create your own journey. You will find your path and deliver your cargo to where it needs to go, all before the cargo explodes, so be sure to find the destination before you pick it up!

There is no right way to get to your destination, so be sure to jump in again and find other paths, and share them here with me!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/e349657300b10e81b753a5baf06af7e5d85ae695.png[/img]
I hope you enjoy the demo, it’s been a passion project of mine for so long and it’s with a mix of anxiety and excitement that I present it to you. If this is your first hearing about ADRIFT, it would mean a lot to me (and the Steam algorithm) if you added the game to your wishlist. 

If you have any feedback please share it here on Steam or in the forums and I'll take it into account - I'm aiming for an improved demo for Next Fest in a few weeks so all feedback is greatly appreciated! You can also get in touch on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/sk98games.bsky.social]BlueSky here[/url].  

Have fun out there, 

Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8

notes.title: The First Trailer
notes.content:
Hi there!

I’m incredibly excited to share the first real trailer for ADRIFT! I’ve made some gameplay videos that I’ve shared around before but this is the first time I’ve got to work with an actual trailer maker. It’s been really exciting to share the vision and the vibe of the game and have someone just _get it_ right away. 

The trailer really gives you a good sense of how much more you will get to see in the full game, while also setting the tone.

[previewyoutube=xn7GQInFDmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

I can’t fully explain how big a moment this is for me, as a solo developer who has been working on this game for so long. To see it told by someone else for the first time, and for it to perfectly capture the game is incredibly validating and rewarding. 

I’ve got a lot more things to show you as development continues so you’re already in the right place. It’s also worth noting that we have a [[link]]bluesky account[[link]] that you can follow. I’ve been posting a lot of screenshots and gifs over there so give me a follow! 

Have fun out there, 

Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8

notes.title: Re-Introducing ADRIFT!
notes.content:
Hi there!

I’m Stefan, I’ve been working on ADRIFT for the last 3 years and I’m incredibly excited to share the game with you. ADRIFT began its life as a student project of mine and I just never stopped working on it through other projects, working as a car mechanic and now a full time solo dev. 

I wanted to create something that could give you the zen-like sensation of driving, the thrill of exploration and then the real pressure of delivering a vital cargo on time. There is no right way to get to your destination with multiple paths and journeys to make.

I can’t wait to share the demo, which is coming soon. ADRIFT has been a passion project of mine for so long and it’s with a mix of anxiety and excitement that I present it to you. If this is your first hearing about ADRIFT, it would mean a lot to me (and the Steam algorithm) if you added the game to your wishlist. You can also find me over on Bluesky where I’ll be sharing regular updates and screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057812/eb8a90f75d01100b4b03aeec844ad178d1a76fc2.gif[/img]

See you out there, 

Stefan | S . K . 9 . 8
